```{python}
#| include: false

import polars as pl
from plotnine import ggplot, aes, geom_col, labs, theme_minimal
```

## Overview

This report covers the **`{python} region`** region for the year **`{python} year`**.
Values below are quarterly totals in thousands.

## Sales by quarter

::: {#fig-sales fig-alt="Bar chart of quarterly sales, one bar per quarter."}

```{python}
sales = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        "quarter": ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"],
        "total": [120, 135, 158, 172],
    }
)

(
    ggplot(sales)
    + aes(x="quarter", y="total")
    + geom_col(fill="#2a9d8f")
    + labs(x="", y="Sales (k)")
    + theme_minimal(base_size=11)
)
```

Quarterly sales for `{python} region` in `{python} year`.

:::

@fig-sales shows steady growth across the year.
